name: ptcli-retorrent
description: Local AI-callable Chinese PT retorrent, upload and daily-candidate service.

auth.required_when: PTCLI_API_TOKEN is configured on the service.

safety.blocked_contract: When rules, duplicate checks, qBittorrent evidence, or required confirmations are missing, APIs return status=blocked with blockers and next_actions.

agent_instructions.poll: When status is queued or running, poll links.self; read links.summary only after a terminal state.
agent_instructions.resume: Resume only from links.resume with explicit allowlisted overrides and required user confirmation.
agent_instructions.complete: Report completion only when status=complete, blockers=[], and summary/evidence prove target seeding closure.

default_workflows.name: seedbox_handoff
stop_when: operator has not explicitly submitted the live request

default_workflows.name: source_url_retorrent
stop_when: blockers is non-empty without a safe resume
accept_rules or confirm_upload is missing for live upload

tools.name: source_url_retorrent_preflight
tools.description: Resolve a user-provided source URL and summarize deployment, policy, confirmation, material, and job-template readiness before creating any live-capable retorrent job. This endpoint never contacts trackers or qBittorrent.

source_tracker.description: Optional tracker code when source is only an id, e.g. U2 or CHD.

target.description: Target tracker code(s), currently live upload closure is MTEAM-focused.

accept_rules.description: Required for source download and live upload automation.

path.description: Existing completed content path on the seedbox.

save_path.description: qBittorrent save path for source torrent download/injection.

uploaded_save_path.description: qBittorrent save path for uploaded target torrent injection.

uploaded_qbit_upload_limit.description: Uploaded target torrent upload limit, e.g. 2MiB/s. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

uploaded_qbit_download_limit.description: Uploaded target torrent download limit. If omitted, PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES may provide a default.

bdinfo_file.description: Existing BDInfo report file to include in the target upload package.

upload_screenshots.description: Upload local/generated screenshots to the configured image host before preparing the target package.

tools.name: daily_candidates_job
tools.description: Create an asynchronous daily-candidate discovery job and return a job_id for polling.

target.description: Target tracker code(s), currently MTEAM duplicate checks are supported.

exclude_source_ids.description: Source torrent ids already covered by the current batch; agents should pass this when refilling shortfalls to avoid duplicate submissions.

tools.name: submit_daily_candidate_job
tools.description: Create a live retorrent job from a ranked item in a completed daily-candidates job. The candidate source/target identity is inherited from the digest; this endpoint only accepts execution overrides such as confirm_upload, save_path, qBittorrent tags, rate limits, and material files.

job_id.description: Completed daily_candidates_job id that contains candidate_digest.push_items.

source_id.description: Optional source torrent id selector. When supplied, it is matched against candidate_digest.push_items[].source_id.

overrides.description: Optional execution overrides. Source/target identity is ignored here and inherited from the selected candidate.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: List recent ptcli jobs with short AI-readable status, blockers, resume plan, lineage, and status/summary/resume endpoints. This endpoint never runs work.

tools.name: get_job_status
tools.description: Return short AI-readable job status, blockers, next actions, duplicate check, summary file, and resume state.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

tools.name: get_job_summary
tools.description: Return the job result, parsed summary-file payload, and direct AI-readable resume/status endpoints when available.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

tools.name: resume_job
tools.description: Create a follow-up job from the allowlisted next_command_argv generated by a blocked or failed job. Optional allowlisted overrides can add missing confirmations, paths, qBittorrent limits, or material files before the resume job is queued.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

dry_run.description: Preview the patched allowlisted resume command without creating a child job or executing it.

accept_rules.description: Optional resume override for --accept-rules; only true values are applied.

confirm_upload.description: Optional resume override for --confirm-upload; only true values are applied.

target_execute.description: Optional resume override for --target-execute; only true values are applied.

enrich_metadata.description: Optional resume override for --enrich-metadata; only true values are applied.

fetch_ptgen.description: Optional resume override for --fetch-ptgen; only true values are applied.

generate_bdinfo.description: Optional resume override for --generate-bdinfo; only true values are applied.

generate_mediainfo.description: Optional resume override for --generate-mediainfo; only true values are applied.

generate_screenshots.description: Optional resume override for --generate-screenshots; only true values are applied.

upload_screenshots.description: Optional resume override for --upload-screenshots; only true values are applied.

download_uploaded_torrent.description: Optional resume override for --download-uploaded-torrent; only true values are applied.

inject_uploaded_torrent.description: Optional resume override for --inject-uploaded-torrent; only true values are applied.

wait_uploaded_complete.description: Optional resume override for --wait-uploaded-complete; only true values are applied.

screenshot_file.description: Optional single screenshot file override; use screenshot_files for multiple files.

tools.name: cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a queued job before it starts. Running jobs are not force-stopped and return 409 so live tracker/qBittorrent work is not interrupted unsafely.

job_id.description: 32-character ptcli job id returned by a job creation endpoint.

reason.description: Optional audit reason for cancelling a queued job.

tools.name: site_policies
tools.description: Return the configured Chinese PT site policy matrix: automation gates, qBittorrent rate limits, seeding requirements, rule URLs, and manual review blockers. This does not contact trackers.

trackers.description: Comma-separated tracker codes or an array, e.g. U2,MTEAM.

source_tracker.description: Optional source tracker code when asking for a source/target pair.

target.description: Optional target tracker code(s) when asking for a source/target pair.

accept_rules.description: Whether manual rule review obligations are acknowledged for this policy read.

config.description: Path to data/config.py inside the container.

tools.name: site_policy_rule_review
tools.description: Turn explicit human tracker-rule review evidence into copyable rule_review_fingerprint config patches. This endpoint never contacts trackers and never edits config by itself.

trackers.description: Optional comma-separated tracker codes or array. Defaults to the full Chinese PT allowlist.

source_tracker.description: Optional source tracker code when asking for a source/target flow profile.

target.description: Optional target tracker code(s), e.g. MTEAM.

accept_rules.description: Whether manual rule review obligations are acknowledged for policy profile readiness.

config.description: Path to data/config.py inside the container.

source_url.description: Optional source tracker details URL; source tracker is inferred when source_tracker is omitted.

rules_reviewed.description: Must be true only after a human reviewed each tracker's current rules.

reviewer.description: Human or local account name that performed the rule review.

reviewed_at.description: Review date/time or audit marker, e.g. 2026-07-21.

rules_url.description: Optional single tracker rules URL override when reviewing one tracker.

rules_urls.description: Optional per-tracker rules URL overrides, e.g. {"U2":"...","MTEAM":"..."}.

notes.description: Optional manual review notes to include in the fingerprint evidence and config patch.

tools.name: site_policy_verify
tools.description: Verify that expected manual rule-review fingerprints are present in current PTCLI.SITE_POLICIES and that the site policy gate is ready. This does not contact trackers or edit config.

trackers.description: Comma-separated tracker codes or an array, e.g. U2,MTEAM.

source_tracker.description: Optional source tracker code when asking for a source/target pair.

target.description: Optional target tracker code(s) when asking for a source/target pair.

accept_rules.description: Whether manual rule review obligations are acknowledged for this policy read.

config.description: Path to data/config.py inside the container.

expected_fingerprints_json.description: JSON object alias for expected_fingerprints, useful from CLI/query strings.

expected_fingerprint.description: TRACKER=FINGERPRINT entry or list of entries.

tools.name: qbit_inspect
tools.description: Read qBittorrent torrent state by optional hash/limit. This endpoint is read-only and returns hash/path/progress/category/tag evidence for AI decisions.

config.description: Path to data/config.py inside the container.

tools.name: deployment_check
tools.description: Check local ptcli deployment readiness: runtime imports, material tools, config mount, cookies/tmp/job/download paths, API token warning, and qBittorrent config presence. This does not contact trackers or qBittorrent.
